pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Pyright is Microsoft's static type checker for Python. It ships a command-line checker (pyright) and a Language Server Protocol server (pyright-langserver) for editors, with the typeshed stubs bundled.
This package installs the npm distribution, a self-contained JavaScript bundle run by Node.js. It is not the PyPI "pyright" wrapper, which downloads the same bundle at runtime.
